title: Do Perturbation Predictors Learn Gene Interactions? Diagnosing Extrapolation in Agentic Screening
abstract: arXiv:2610.18880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-throughput perturbation screens increasingly use machine-learning models to predict the effects of gene combinations that were never measured. A difficult case arises when both genes in a test pair were seen individually during training, but their combination was not. In this setting, standard OOD methods often fail because neither gene appears unfamiliar on its own. We therefore compare each model prediction with a simple additive prediction obtained by summing the two observed single-gene effects. The difference between them, which we call additive disagreement (AD), measures how much extra interaction effect the model introduces for an unseen combination. Across eight prediction methods and three Perturb-seq datasets, specialised neural predictors do not consistently outperform this simple additive baseline. translated_title: 扰动预测器能学到基因相互作用吗？——智能体筛选中的外推能力诊断
translated_abstract: 高通量扰动筛选正越来越多地使用机器学习模型来预测那些从未被实际测量过的基因组合的效应。一个困难的情形是：测试基因对中的两个基因在训练时都被单独见过，但它们的组合却从未出现。在这种设定下，标准的分布外（OOD）方法往往会失效，因为单独来看任何一个基因都不显得陌生。因此，我们将每个模型的预测与一个简单的加性预测进行比较，后者由两个已观测到的单基因效应相加得到。二者之间的差异——我们称之为加性分歧——衡量了模型为未见组合所引入的额外相互作用效应的大小。在八种预测方法和三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，专门的神经预测器并不能稳定地优于这一简单的加性基线。更重要的是，偏离加性基线越大的预测往往具有越大的误差。常规的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“加性分歧”这一诊断指标来评估扰动预测模型对未见基因组合的外推能力，并发现在八种方法和三个 Perturb-seq 数据集上，专门的神经预测器并不稳定优于简单的加性基线，且偏离加性基线越大的预测误差越大。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "additive disagreement" (AD) as a diagnostic for extrapolation in perturbation predictors, showing across eight methods and three Perturb-seq datasets that specialized neural models fail to consistently outperform a simple additive baseline, and predictions that deviate more from this baseline tend to have larger errors.
